", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u025-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“We want to take them to their home, don’t we?”", "sha256": "9a93cfabc1bf706ad4b1bf1ed63fed128cff85ecd854eb98198ca35941fcbde2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[25]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u025-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“La, but list to him! They be of all the regions of the earth!
